name: wall-press-90-90-extension
instructions:
1. Setup in a supine position with your legs in a 90/90 position (90 degree bend at the hips and knees) and your arms overhead pressing into a wall.
2. Extend one leg while you exhale.
3. Return back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
4. Repeat for the desired number of total repetitions.
